title: 21. Howe the miſterie of our ſaluation was fulfilled in Ieſus Chriſt.

segments.text:
WE confeſſe then that for to fulfyll the couenante promiſed to the auncient fathers and propheſied by the mouthe of the prophets. The trew and only eternal ſonne of God in the time ordeined of the father toke on him the forme of a ſeruaunte, that is to ſay, a very humane nature with the infirmities of the ſame, ſinne excepted, beinge conceyued in the wombe of the bleſſed vyrgin Mary
by the vertue of the holy, ghoſte without any operation of man.
